QuestInfo.name: The Missing Seal Stone of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: The lab was hit by the Black Wings. Were they trying to get ahold of the records, or something else? Go ask #b#p2020005##k.
QuestInfo.1:
You asked about the Seal Stone, and it was in #p2020005#'s laboratory the whole time. The diary might still be intact, so #breturn to the laboratory#k.

#i4033125# #t4033125# #b#c4033125# / 1#k

#e#b<If you fail to complete the quest, you must forfeit and start again.>#k#n
QuestInfo.2: The journals are totally illegible. According to #p2020005#, his teacher lost his life during the war 300 years ago. Many records and libraries burned at the same time, so it's likely much of that history was destroyed.\n\nYou remember yelling at Aran for dropping the ball long ago, but it looks like you lost a Seal Stone as well...

0.0: It doesn't make sense. What value would anyone find in an old personal journal? It was nothing but personal musings... \r\n#L0##bWas there anything else they might have had an interest in? Formulas, schematics, treasure maps... jewels?#l\n#k
0.1: The only jewel in that laboratory was a worthless old thing that my teacher once referred to as a #rSeal Stone#k. I found no use for it in my incantations or alchemies. \r\n#L0##bI fear that is exactly what they were after, Alcaster. The Seal Stone of #m211000000# was in my hands and I let them have it!#l\n#k
0.2: That's what they were after? It is hard to say which side is more foolish. That stone was unusable, even in the most skilled hands. I suppose my old journals will have been left untouched, should you still desire them. \r\n#b#e<You will be moved to the map if you accept.>#n#k

yes.0: If you search carefully, you may still find the journals.

no.0: Do you think they would have taken the journals as well? It might be worth a trip back to check.

1.0: This #t4033125# is a mess! I can't read a word of it. I was really hoping to tell you more of the #rwar 300 years ago#k. \r\n#L0##bThere was a war 300 years ago?! I'm so behind the times. I should hire someone to catch me up on history...#l\n#k
1.1: Most people your age are totally unaware of the war, though all of Maple World once struggled under its influence. Fortunately, thanks to the feats of people like Athena Pierce, peace and order returned.\r\n#L0##b(MY AGE? Yeesh. It's strange to think of that shy little elf being a leader, but she was a big help in my day...)#l\n#k
1.2: Much was lost when the war descended upon our towns and homes. The records of that time seem to have vanished in the flames; kindling for an unwanted battle. \r\n#L0##bI'm not sure that loss of history was entirely by accident, but we'll just have to see.#l\n#k
1.3: War takes much from us, including our past. I hope that the young will never have to face those horrors again.

item.0: Are you certain the journals were gone? There would be no useful information...
